records.name: long_doc
records.text: This group meets twice a week in the engineering library for computer networks. Topics include TCP/IP, routing, congestion control, socket programming, and Wireshark labs. Members are CS and CE undergraduates preparing for midterms. We also cover subnetting, DNS, HTTP, and a short unit on wireless. Bring a laptop and the Kurose Ross textbook. The session runs two hours with a short break. New members are welcome if they have completed the intro systems course.
